adapted: Hermes Agent Bot Desktop runtime, lease/lock, display allocation and thumbnail concepts; rewritten in TypeScript for Briefsip.

takeover.logic: Hermes single-holder lease, persistent holder/since/epoch, request reason, and tool-level human-control fence translated into TypeScript. Briefsip uses SQLite revisions, its own durable turn pause/resume journal, screenshot hand-back note, authenticated noVNC RFB relay and three-viewer cap; no Hermes runtime or UI copied.

vnc_relay.adaptation: RFB message framing and server-side watch-mode input filtering rewritten for Briefsip; no Bot HQ runtime or assets used.

dependencies.adaptation: Unmodified RFB browser client used by app/src/ComputerViewer.tsx; license retained in app/novnc.LICENSE; upstream https://github.com/novnc/noVNC/tree/v1.7.0.

desktop_session.adaptation: Rust supervisor for TigerVNC Unix socket, component-wise Xfce, terminal launcher and private D-Bus. Briefsip owns the bwrap mounts, network namespace and Unix proxy relay.
